name: Abyssal Contacts
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
We've seen the Twilight's Hammer cultists performing rituals to summon powerful elemental nobles.  We don't know if these are the beings the cultists worship or if they act as intermediaries to even more powerful forces.  One thing is for sure: they are receiving orders from these elementals.

I want you to find a way to contact an Abyssal Templar and give it a proper beating!  Nothing throws the troops in disarray like taking out the chain of command.  Bring back proof while you're at it.
narrative.objectives: Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to destroy an Abyssal Templar and bring him an Abyssal Crest as proof of the deed.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hah! You did it, adventurer! The Twilight's Hammer will soon be crushed!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 6,600 XP in all.
